The claim that deep ecology holds that nature matters only for human benefit is a common mistake about the view, often described as "instrumentalist misreading of deep ecology". A fair assessment also has to reckon with this worry: it can conflict with human needs. A careful reader separates the actual doctrine from the frequent misreading.
